title: Proposition 4.1: unramifiedness of TSp_Zar(k) and TSp_et(k)
statement_scope: Let k be a connective E∞-ring. Then the pregeometry TSp_Zar(k) of Definition VII.2.18 and the pregeometry TSp_et(k) of Definition VII.8.26 are unramified. The author gives the proof for TSp_et(k), with TSp_Zar(k) similar and easier, and reduces unramifiedness to the printed assertion (*) for E∞-algebras A, B, C over k in TSp_et(k) and a morphism φ:B→A in CAlg_k; the induced diagram of étale-sheaf ∞-topoi is a pullback, identified through the localization U and Proposition T.7.3.2.13. Whole proposition, not split.
